claim_text: Council Decision 2016/1841 was adopted on 5 October 2016.
The Paris Agreement was signed on 22 April 2016.
The Paris Agreement replaces the 2005 Kyoto Protocol.
The Paris Agreement aims to keep global warming well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels.

gold_evidence.quote: keep the global temperature increase well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels

claim_text: The 21st COP to the UNFCCC took place in Paris from 30 November to 12 December 2015.
Council Decision 2015/2071 concerns the Forced Labour Convention of 1950.
Council Decision 2015/2071 authorises Member States to ratify the Protocol of 2014.
The EU aims to eradicate trafficking in human beings inside and outside the Union.
The Paris Agreement requires at least 70 parties to deposit instruments of ratification before entry into force.

gold_evidence.quote: 55 Parties to the UNFCCC accounting in total for at least an estimated 55 % of total greenhouse gas emissions

claim_text: Council Decision 2016/1841 establishes penalties for Member States that fail to reduce emissions.
